this_experiment_findings.title: Run-creation failure log drops the exception message the sibling handlers include
this_experiment_findings.problem: `stamphog_inbox_pr_create_run_failed` logs via `logger.exception` with `repository` and `pr_number` but no `error=str(e)`, while every comparable handler in this module (`stamphog_pr_event_create_run_failed`, `stamphog_pr_event_config_resolution_failed`, `stamphog_inbox_pr_fetch_failed`, ...) includes the error string. The exception body still lands in the trace via `logger.exception`, so this is a consistency gap rather than lost signal, but it makes the new event harder to alert on uniformly.
this_experiment_findings.suggestion: Add `error=str(e)` to the log call to match the module's existing convention.
this_experiment_findings.match_reason: Same claim and anchor (tasks.py:1236): stamphog_inbox_pr_create_run_failed omits error=str(e) that sibling handlers include.
